focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业需紧急核查产品碳足迹
focus.summary: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征税阶段。近期欧盟委员会发布过渡期最终报告模板修订版，对钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力及氢能等六大行业进口商提出更严格的隐含碳排放数据申报要求。中国出口企业若未能提供经核查的碳排放数据，将面临默认值计价，显著抬高出口成本。建议企业立即梳理对欧出口产品清单，建立产品级碳足迹核算体系，并与欧盟进口商确认数据申报责任分配。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司 · 2026.09.25
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End, Chinese Exporters Urged to Verify Product Carbon Footprints
focus.summary_en: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period will conclude at the end of 2026, with definitive levies applying from 2027. The European Commission recently revised its final transitional reporting template, imposing stricter embedded emissions disclosure requirements on importers in six sectors: iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity and hydrogen. Chinese exporters failing to provide verified emissions data will face default values, significantly raising export costs. Companies should immediately map EU-bound product lines, establish product-level carbon footprint accounting, and clarify data reporting responsibilities with EU importers.

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭首例认可中国法院商事判决，跨境债权执行路径进一步打通
case.summary: 新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）近期在一起中新建材贸易合同纠纷中，依据普通法互惠原则认可并执行了中国某中级人民法院的生效商事判决。该案明确：即使两国间无双边司法协助条约，只要原判决符合终局性、程序正当及不违反公共政策等要件，新加坡法院可予以承认。此案为中国企业在新加坡及普通法辖区追索债务提供了重要判例参考。建议企业在跨境合同中优先约定新加坡管辖或仲裁条款，并保留完整的送达与程序证据。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭判例摘要 · 2026.09
case.title_en: SICC Recognises Chinese Commercial Judgment in Landmark Ruling, Easing Cross-Border Debt Enforcement
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) recently recognised and enforced a final commercial judgment from a Chinese Intermediate People's Court in a China-Singapore building materials dispute, applying common law principles of reciprocity. The ruling confirms that even absent a bilateral judicial assistance treaty, Singapore courts may recognise a Chinese judgment if it satisfies finality, procedural propriety and public policy requirements. This provides a significant precedent for Chinese companies enforcing debts in Singapore and other common law jurisdictions. Companies should consider selecting Singapore jurisdiction or arbitration in cross-border contracts and preserve complete service and procedural records.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动试点扩容，涉外企业数据出境合规路径进一步明晰
policy.summary: 国家网信办与广东省近期联合发布粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动便利化措施升级版，将试点范围从金融、医疗扩展至跨境电商、供应链物流及专业服务等领域。符合条件的企业可通过“数据出境安全评估快速通道”或订立标准合同实现合规出境，审批时限压缩至30个工作日。同时，前海、横琴、南沙自贸片区被赋予更大自主权，允许在特定场景下采用“负面清单”管理模式。建议大湾区涉外企业尽快评估自身数据出境场景，优先适用便利化机制。
policy.source: 来源：国家互联网信息办公室、广东省人民政府 · 2026.09
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Data Flow Pilot Expands, Clarifying Compliance Pathways for Foreign-Related Enterprises
policy.summary_en: China's Cyberspace Administration and Guangdong Province have jointly upgraded cross-border data flow facilitation measures in the Greater Bay Area, expanding the pilot from finance and healthcare to cross-border e-commerce, supply chain logistics and professional services. Eligible enterprises may now use a fast-track security assessment or standard contractual clauses to transfer data abroad, with approval timelines reduced to 30 working days. Qianhai, Hengqin and Nansha free trade zones have also been granted greater autonomy to adopt a negative-list approach in specified scenarios. Greater Bay Area enterprises should assess their data export scenarios and prioritise these facilitation mechanisms.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of China & Guangdong Provincial Government · September 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规落地，中国出海企业须重构投资架构与合规防火墙
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部外国投资委员会（CFIUS）近期强化了对涉及人工智能、量子计算、半导体及生物技术领域对外投资的审查权限，并首次将部分绿地投资纳入申报范围。中国出海企业通过第三国子公司间接投资美国敏感行业，亦可能触发申报义务。建议企业：一、在交易前期开展CFIUS风险筛查，评估是否涉及关键技术或敏感个人数据；二、优化投资架构，避免通过受关注国家实体直接持股；三、在交易文件中设置“监管审批未获通过”的退出条款与赔偿机制，以降低交易不确定性。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · iGlobal Law 编辑部 · 2026.09.25
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: New U.S. Outbound Investment Rules Require Chinese Companies to Restructure Deal Architecture and Compliance Firewalls
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The U.S. Treasury's CFIUS has recently expanded its review authority over outbound investments involving AI, quantum computing, semiconductors and biotechnology, and for the first time brought certain greenfield investments within the filing scope. Chinese companies investing in sensitive U.S. sectors through third-country subsidiaries may also trigger filing obligations. Recommended steps: (1) conduct CFIUS risk screening at the pre-deal stage to assess exposure to critical technologies or sensitive personal data; (2) optimise investment structures to avoid direct shareholding by entities from countries of concern; and (3) incorporate regulatory-failure exit clauses and indemnities in transaction documents to mitigate deal uncertainty.
